_about: Every public-domain John Owen (1616-1683) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is the complete Goold edition (The Works of John Owen, ed. William H. Goold, Edinburgh: Johnstone & Hunter, 1850-1855; 24 volumes, vols. 18-24 the Exposition of Hebrews), Internet Archive OCR text, raw and unconverted (the Edwards precedent). Each volume number was read from the title-page OCR, not from IA metadata. CCEL ThML is fetched for every CCEL Owen title not already held. No Gutenberg Owen exists (searched 2026-10-02). Banner of Truth reprints (1965 onward) and modern editions are excluded: their editorial matter may be in copyright.
